summary: Phase 3 (Validation + View Original + Draft auto-save + Signature capture) partially verified end-to-end via Playwright against the preview URL as admin@healthguard.com (Supabase). Header of DynamicFormRenderer for SKilleRN-Fillable now exposes new `dyn-view-original` icon-button (renders the PdfViewerModal on top of the form; `pdf-close` reachable and successfully dismissed) alongside `dyn-form-submit`/`dyn-form-close`. Field counts unchanged from Phase 2 baseline: 142 dyn-field TextInputs + 12 dyn-radio chips + 33 dyn-check chips + 1 dyn-signature — regression clean. Draft auto-save writes AsyncStorage key `formDraft:5653960d-74b8-4b81-944a-af68f4d53e75` (localStorage on RN-web) after ~500ms debounce; values are correctly restored on reopen (Date='2026-01-15', Last Name='Draft-Smith', First='Draft-John' all persisted verbatim). Signature capture modal opens with `dyn-sig-cancel`/`dyn-sig-clear`/`dyn-sig-save` + a live <canvas> element from react-native-signature-canvas WebView. Validation infra renders inline `dyn-error-<field>` and error banner. NOTE: two behavioural observations flagged for main agent below — (1) `dyn-draft-restored` banner test could not observe the banner visually within the polling window (values were still restored, and the banner selector never resolved) — likely because the banner auto-dismisses after 4s and the schema/localStorage load path may already be past that window on preview latency, but this may also be a race we should double-check; (2) the date validator regex `/^(?:\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{2,4})$/` permissively accepts nonsense like '99/99/9999' (all-digit syntactic pass) — this matches the code's declared 'catch obvious typos, not bank-grade' intent, but the spec's own repro string '99/99/9999' will NOT trip the validator. Additionally the duplicate-key React warnings from iteration 24 are still spamming the console (four .options.map((opt) => <Pressable key={opt}>) sites in DynamicFormRenderer.tsx). No backend regressions attempted (per task scope 'frontend only'); Phase 2 pytest coverage from iteration 24 still covers POST /submissions.

ui_bugs.issue: `dyn-draft-restored` banner element was NOT observed in the DOM across polling windows on reopen, even though the draft VALUES restored correctly (Date/Last Name/First all pre-filled from AsyncStorage). Because the banner has a hard 4000ms setTimeout auto-dismiss started INSIDE loadSchema right after the async schema fetch, if the preview network is fast the banner may appear briefly (<4s) but Playwright's poll never caught it. Recommend increasing timeout to 6-8s or gating the auto-dismiss on a user gesture; also add a startTime guard so the timer starts when render commits, not when state is set. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/DynamicFormRenderer.tsx:189-192, 713-723

FMT_DATE = /^(?:\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}|\d{1,2}\/\d{1,2}\/\d{2,4})$/ passes '99/99/9999' verbatim — the spec's own repro string will NOT surface an inline error, so the Alert 'Fix errors' + `dyn-error-Date` path shown to a user typing 99/99/9999 will never trigger. Truly non-numeric input like 'abc' DOES trip the validator. If the intent is stronger day/month bounds, add range checks (1-12 / 1-31). Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/DynamicFormRenderer.tsx:51

action_items: Investigate why `dyn-draft-restored` banner was not observable via Playwright polling immediately after reopen even though draft VALUES restored correctly. Suggest: (a) delay the setTimeout(dismiss, 4000) to fire after a small microtask so the banner has committed before the timer starts; (b) or bump the auto-dismiss window to 8s; (c) or add a `data-testid` that stays mounted even after the fade so tests can assert the presence via a `hidden` attr. Confirm the banner actually renders for a real human by manual QA — the values ARE restored so the hadDraft branch DID execute.

Strengthen FMT_DATE — either narrow the regex (e.g. day 01-31, month 01-12) or clarify UX copy 'Use YYYY-MM-DD or MM/DD/YYYY' to include an explicit example that would fail (currently '99/99/9999' silently passes).

Fix remaining duplicate-key React warnings in DynamicFormRenderer.tsx: 4 sites still using bare `key={opt}` on .options.map — switch all to composite `key={`${opt}-${idx}`}`. Non-blocking but noisy in dev console.

OPTIONAL: manually verify signature draw → Save round-trip end-to-end on the real device — Playwright mouse.down/move/up over the WebView-hosted canvas can be flaky on web preview because react-native-signature-canvas relies on pointer events inside a nested WebView.
Update /app/test_result.md with a Phase 3 frontend task; do not mark working=true unconditionally until the draft-banner visibility question is resolved with a real-user check.
critical_code_review_comments: DynamicFormRenderer.tsx is now ~1200 lines. Consider splitting SignatureCaptureModal into its own file (already private, clean seam).

The 500ms debounced auto-save is guarded by `hasContent` — good (avoids clobbering with empty state on first mount). The load path calls `setValues({})` before the async schema fetch resolves; if the user closes+reopens rapidly this could race with the still-in-flight debounce timer from the previous open. Consider clearing the debounce on close.

PdfViewerModal is nested INSIDE the outer form Modal. On iOS this is supported; on Android historically you sometimes need `hardwareAccelerated={false}` on the nested modal to avoid flicker. Preview web is fine.
The signature auto-clear on submit path uses `AsyncStorage.removeItem(draftKey).catch(() => {})` — good (non-blocking).
Backend was NOT modified in this iteration (verified by inspection). Signature base64 flows through the same generic `values` dict that iteration 24 test coverage exercises.

success_rate.frontend: ~70% — 4/6 Phase 3 flows fully green (view original PDF, draft persistence to localStorage, draft value restoration on reopen, signature modal opens + testIDs correct + canvas present). 2 flows partial: draft banner visibility not observed by automation, and date validation regex too permissive for '99/99/9999'. Signature full round-trip (canvas draw → readSignature → base64 in values → captured UI) not fully asserted end-to-end via Playwright due to WebView pointer-event fragility.

seed_data_creation: None new — reused SKilleRN-Fillable doc (id 5653960d-74b8-4b81-944a-af68f4d53e75) seeded in iteration 24.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AsyncStorage on RN-web maps to localStorage; inspect via `Object.keys(window.localStorage).filter(k => k.includes('formDraft'))` and `JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('formDraft:5653960d-74b8-4b81-944a-af68f4d53e75'))`. The draft banner has a 4000ms auto-dismiss inside loadSchema — poll with wait_for_timeout <200ms increments IMMEDIATELY after clicking the reopen button to catch it (or set a longer window in code). To draw a signature: locate `canvas` inside the sig modal, bounding_box(), then page.mouse.down/move/up. Signature-canvas onOK fires with the base64 PNG. If Playwright can't consistently capture the draw on the WebView-hosted canvas, an alternative is to inject via `page.evaluate` a direct set on the DynamicFormRenderer state — but the preferred path is the real user drag. All frontend testIDs verified present: dyn-view-original, dyn-form-submit, dyn-form-close, dyn-form-submit-footer, dyn-field-<name>, dyn-radio-<name>-<opt>, dyn-check-<name>-<opt>, dyn-signature-<name>, dyn-signature-clear-<name>, dyn-sig-cancel, dyn-sig-clear, dyn-sig-save, dyn-error-<name>, dyn-error-banner, dyn-draft-restored, dyn-draft-discard, pdf-close.
rca_of_issue: Draft banner not observed: the auto-dismiss timer (setTimeout(setRestoredBanner(false), 4000)) fires 4s after the state transition inside loadSchema, which happens BEFORE the ScrollView is committed (loading=false triggers a re-render). In slow-network preview environments the initial paint may already consume 1-2s, leaving <2s of banner visible to a poller — my 150ms poll should still catch it, but under load could miss. RECOMMEND: guard the auto-dismiss on the *committed* first paint using useLayoutEffect, or simply bump to 8000ms. Values restoration itself is fully working — evidence: localStorage key survives close/reopen and TextInputs re-populate.
